svg.title: Two zooms of the same neck pinch
svg.desc: Parabolic rescaling makes the neck collapse to rays, while the finer Type II rescaling retains a smooth Lawlor neck. Exact profiles, schematic time law; n=3 and K=2.
svg.text: The scale determines what you see
n = 3, K = 2 · planar sections of the asymptotic model · q = 1 − τ
Three times approach the dashed rays
The true flow converges to these limits; this figure omits its parabolic correction.
